name: Gruppe Sechs
summary: Private armed security and armored transit corporation providing cash transfers across banks, casinos, and high-end businesses throughout Leonida. Frequent heist targets.
description: Gruppe Sechs armored vans ('Putting U in Security') cruise the commercial corridors of Vice City transporting substantial deposits of currency. Heavily armored and defended by shotgun-wielding guards, these security vehicles provide lucrative impromptu ambush opportunities for Lucia and Jason in free-roam.

seo.title: Gruppe Sechs: Armored Security Transits
seo.description: Gruppe Sechs security in GTA VI. Armored van routes, cash robbery strategies, security uniforms, and high-payout heist targets.
